{nakamoto} Favaki #147179 (Nakamoto) gave the body and the hair
{rabbit} The White Rabbit? Nobody invited him. He left his EARS anyway.

✅ Looks only: same species, same stats, nothing lost
✅ Pet page shows a 👑 LEGENDARY MIX badge + "Traded parts"
✅ Live since Oct 22, so you might already own one. Go check your hybrids 👀
